shortDescription: Remove a user from a Semaphore project

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authentication. Use this or C(session_cookie).

options.name: host
options.description: Base URL of the Semaphore server including scheme, for example C(http://localhost).

options.name: port
options.description: Port where the Semaphore API is exposed, for example C(3000).

options.name: project_id
options.description: ID of the project to remove the user from.

options.name: session_cookie
options.description: Session cookie for authentication. Use this or C(api_token).

options.name: user_id
options.description: ID of the user to unlink from the project.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate TLS certificates when using HTTPS.
